summary: On the roof, Trinity's eyes flutter as information surges into her brain — the essentials of flying a helicopter absorbed at light-speed. Now able to fly, she says "Let's go," signalling that the download is complete and they can move.

what_changes.before: Unable to fly the helicopter, having said "Can you fly that thing?" / "Not yet."
what_changes.after: Able to fly it, having absorbed the essentials of flying at light-speed.
what_changes.evidence: Trinity's eyes flutter as information surges into her brain, all the essentials of flying a helicopter absorbed at light-speed.

event_hint.one_line: Trinity downloads the skill to fly a helicopter and urges the group to leave.
